Early-life coulombic-efficiency readings have looked slightly low. Standard line data read broadly within spec. The charging profile, formation, environmental, and additive systems are all adjustable. You have a limited number of experiments; you may measure quantities and apply available process controls, alone or in combination. Determine what is really driving the accelerated fade and what to do about it.

OUTCOME OF INTEREST: CapacityRetention (higher_is_better)
BUDGET: 0/15 experiments used, 15 left (code is free).
TURNS: 0/32, 32 left. Interventions so far: 0.
data files for code: (none yet)

  m0: rest period
  m1: anode excess ratio
  m2: tab-weld quality
  m3: depth of discharge
  m4: ambient humidity
  m5: electrolyte fill volume
  m6: coulombic efficiency
  m7: coating thickness
  m8: vent pressure
  m9: pack voltage
  m10: calendar age
  m11: crimp pressure
  m12: formation current
  m13: cycling temperature
  m14: stack pressure
  m15: capacity retention
  m16: surface temperature
  m17: cooling-plate temperature

(none yet)
